slowdown.growth: -shock × trade openness divided by 60, bounded from 0.5 to 1.5

rates.source: illustrative one year pass through assumption

aiProductivity.growth: uplift × AI Trajectory Index readiness divided by 100

limits: Only 19 countries and roughly 25 annual observations per country
Structural breaks can make historical relationships fail
No forward looking policy information is used

Methods are chosen on the early backtest origins and scored on the later ones, but a method is kept only if it also wins on those later origins, so a quoted skill still carries the mild optimism of that last check
Held out origins are dominated by 2020 to 2025, so quoted errors are larger and band coverage lower than a calmer period would give
Scenarios are illustrative assumptions, not forecasts
